name: autopay_refund
description: User wants a refund for an unauthorized or incorrect UPI autopay debit
context_question: I'm sorry to hear that. Could you briefly describe what happened — when did this debit occur, and was it something you had authorized before?

name: autopay_cancel
description: User wants to cancel an active autopay subscription
context_question: Sure, I can help with that. Can you tell me why you want to cancel — is this a service issue, unexpected charges, or you simply don't need it anymore?

name: charge_dispute
description: User is disputing an unknown or incorrect charge on their account
context_question: I understand your concern. Can you walk me through what you noticed — what was the charge amount, and do you have any idea where it might have come from?

name: card_block
description: User wants to block their debit or credit card
context_question: I'll help you block it right away. Before I do — can you tell me what happened? Was the card lost, stolen, or are you seeing suspicious transactions?
